title: Exhaust System & Emissions Issues
subtitle: Rattles, sulfur smells, and catalyst codes — safe inspection first, emissions legality always.

prerequisites: Cold or cool exhaust for close visuals

adaptive_rules.coach_note: P0420/P0430 often needs confirmation — don't replace a cat on a code alone without upstream fixes.
Diesel DPF/DEF issues need proper regen diagnosis — forced deletes are illegal in many regions.
High-mile exhaust: hangers, flex pipes, and heat shields rattle before cats fail.
EU/UK MOT/emissions rules are strict — keep original emissions equipment intact.
